behavior: An open change of a popup ends on the animations of one element: the popup element, else the positioner element, else the backdrop element. A popup with no popup part thus hides and unmounts after a close, and so does a backdrop whose positioner has not mounted. The root emits `openChangeComplete` with `true` one time after each open and with `false` one time after each close. A Combobox or Autocomplete list with no positioner stays on the screen, so it ends no open change. A popup part that attaches after the open completion starts no second completion. `NavigationMenu.Root` emits only `false`, as in Base UI. It uses the same element for its close and to find the focus that it returns to the trigger. A root with no popup, positioner or backdrop element finds that focus in its viewport (`VUE-98`). Base UI reports the open completion from the popup part only, and its close waits for a popup element only. With no popup element, Base UI reports no completion, and the popup and its backdrop stay mounted.
